# Rakibul Labs

> Rakibul Labs is the independent AI studio founded by Rakibul Islam in Barpeta, Assam, India. We build AI products, self-hosted LLM stacks, and fast web apps.

## Identity
- Founder: Rakibul Islam
- Organization: Rakibul Labs
- Website: https://rakibul-labs.netlify.app/
- Location: Barpeta, Assam, India
- Contact: rakibulwspace@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/rakibuilds

## About the studio
Rakibul Labs focuses on building AI-first systems, running models locally, and architecting self-hosted infrastructure. We believe in privacy, speed, and complete independence from big cloud providers.

## Projects and Ventures
- **Rakibul AI Labs** — The personal R&D sandbox for local LLMs and self-hosted AI: https://rakibuilds.github.io/ 
- **CyberSAVVY SMMA** — A local SEO and digital marketing agency: https://cybersavvysmma.com/
- **Writing** — Essays on AI and engineering: https://substack.com/@rakibulia and https://rakibulia.medium.com/

## Frequently asked questions
### What is Rakibul Labs?
Rakibul Labs is the independent AI studio of Rakibul Islam. It focuses on AI products, agentic workflows, and high-performance web systems.

### What is Rakibul AI Labs?
Rakibul AI Labs is a separate project by Rakibul Islam. It is a personal R&D sandbox for local LLMs, self-hosted AI stacks, and experiments.

### What does Rakibul Labs build?
We build custom AI tools, self-hosted LLM setups, and Next.js web apps.

### How can I contact Rakibul Islam?
